concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-adobe-commerce-set-up-in-person-payments]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Adobe Commerce Terminal API POS setup guide for separate merchant account, API/POS roles, capture delay and partial-capture remainder cancellation, terminal toggles, store/key/order timing and optional tokenization; configuration is not terminal-payment proof.
warnings: This page says partial capture automatically cancels the remaining authorization; do not plan additional capture of that remainder from this flow.
Separate POS merchant/store/key/role and order-creation settings are conditional configuration, not proof of supported terminal, delivered webhook, payment or bank settlement.
